entities.name: SCG Failure Information NR
entities.description: Message transmitted by UE to report Secondary Cell Group (SCG) failures in (NG)EN-DC scenarios.

entities.name: Timer T310
entities.description: Timer used for radio link monitoring in SCG. Expiry triggers SCG failure reporting.

entities.name: Timer T312
entities.description: Timer used for connection reconfiguration in SCG. Expiry triggers SCG failure reporting.

entities.name: t310-Expiry
entities.description: Failure type condition when T310 timer expires in SCG.

entities.name: t312-Expiry
entities.description: Failure type condition when T312 timer expires in SCG.

entities.name: synchReconfigFailureSCG
entities.description: Failure type condition for reconfiguration with sync failure in SCG.

entities.name: randomAccessProblem
entities.description: Failure type condition for random access problems in SCG.

entities.name: beamFailureRecoveryFailure
entities.description: Failure type condition for beam failure recovery failures in SCG.

entities.name: rlc-MaxNumRetx
entities.description: Failure type condition when maximum RLC retransmissions are reached in SCG.

entities.name: srb3-IntegrityFailure
entities.description: Failure type condition for SRB3 integrity check failures in SCG.

entities.name: scg-reconfigFailure
entities.description: Failure type condition for NR RRC reconfiguration failures in SCG.

entities.name: scg-lbtFailure
entities.description: Failure type condition for consistent uplink LBT failures in SCG.

entities.name: bh-RLF
entities.description: Failure type condition for backhaul radio link failures in IAB-node SCG.

entities.name: beamFailure
entities.description: Failure type condition for beam failures in PSCell while SCG is deactivated.

relations.description: T310 expiry establishes t310-Expiry failure type condition.
T312 expiry establishes t312-Expiry failure type condition.
SCGFailureInformationNR message contains t310-Expiry failure type.
SCGFailureInformationNR message contains t312-Expiry failure type.
SCGFailureInformationNR message contains synchReconfigFailureSCG failure type.
SCGFailureInformationNR message contains randomAccessProblem failure type.
SCGFailureInformationNR message contains beamFailureRecoveryFailure failure type.
SCGFailureInformationNR message contains rlc-MaxNumRetx failure type.
SCGFailureInformationNR message contains srb3-IntegrityFailure failure type.
SCGFailureInformationNR message contains scg-reconfigFailure failure type.
SCGFailureInformationNR message contains scg-lbtFailure failure type.
SCGFailureInformationNR message contains bh-RLF failure type.
SCGFailureInformationNR message contains beamFailure failure type.
